Invoice-summary and PDF improvements are complete but remain uncommitted. Tenant 73 processing was reduced from 2,417 SQL statements to 37 while preserving all 14,802 aggregates; runtime improved from roughly 39 seconds to 4.3–4.5 seconds. Invoice-summary, reports, PDF, and billing tests passed, including the full suite with 149 passed and 2 skipped. PDF behavior has operator approval, and Ruff plus `git diff --check` had passed before the latest edits. An optional visual PDF comparison is still available.

The SQLAlchemy modernization for touched areas is complete: models use `DeclarativeBase`, invoice retrieval uses `session.get()`, deprecated query `.get()` calls are removed, SQL echo is disabled, and UTC defaults are timezone-aware. Repository tests passed (83), without `LegacyAPIWarning` from invoice lookup. Billing now supports an injected session; its 26 tests passed, including rollback behavior that preserves account balance.

The latest pagination-warning fix wraps the query in an outer `select()` with `limit()` and `offset()`; 31 invoice API tests passed. Rerun the full suite and inspect warnings to confirm the warning is gone. Ruff still reports two FastAPI `B008` dependency-default warnings and unused imports introduced during UTC/wildcard-import cleanup. Also review legacy session factories in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py` for lifecycle/compatibility. Defer CI/cache work and broader redesigns.
